_note: THE INDUSTRIAL FAMILY, 1 OF 10: THE RUNAWAY PLANT.

THE HOOK (10-28): the plant itself is the voice, a polite control system announcing the shutdown to everyone, guns included. Rewritten 2026-10-28 on his bar, "just about making each mission feel interesting in some way" (and "go ahead on the 7"): the draft had nothing in it worth mentioning afterwards.
The plant was left running when its crew ran, and it is about to cook itself. Shut it down from the control terminal
and keep the occupiers off it while it winds down. The verb is STOP.
Industrial dungeons (LocTypeDungeon_ThemeIndustrial, 20 per Eliza's count), vanilla interiors that carry the
delve markers today. Every word holds in any of them: nothing names the site, the faction or what the plant
made; everything a line points at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Industrial dungeons; the delve marker set.

prose.name: Repairs: Runaway Plant on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The <Place> has been running unattended since its crew fled, and its owners say it won't last much longer.
prose.card: Local Contract. Shut down the runaway plant at the <Place> on <Planet>. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: The shutdown is running, and the plant announces every step of it over the speakers, very politely, to everyone, including the people with guns. I need to keep the terminal safe until it finishes.
beats.name: Plant Control Terminal
say: Shutdown authorised. Estimated time to completion is several minutes. All occupants have been informed of the change, which was not my decision.

beats.objective: Defend the terminal during the shutdown
beats.journal: The <Place> is cold. Its system announced the last step and then had nothing left to say.
say: Shutdown complete. All systems are cold, and the facility is safe.

broadcast: Visitor detected. This facility has been operating outside safe limits for thirty-one days, and a shutdown can be authorised from the control terminal. Please be aware that the facility is also occupied.
_speech: The plant's own control system on the site speakers (10-28). Wants a calm synthetic voice; the voice id is the old owners' until his ear picks one. No names, places, factions or currency.
